dedupe_keys.name: euris api european river information services data interfaces

description: The EuRIS API gives programmatic access to the European River Information Services portal, which brings together data on the main European waterways from the waterway management organisations of the participating countries. Coverage: the documentation names three kinds of use: real-time vessel information and lock statuses for navigation or fleet management, planned routes, voyage details and vessel progress through key waterways, and infrastructure details on ports, terminals, bridges and locks for logistics planning or mapping. It is organised into getting-started, fundamentals (versioning, pagination, error handling and rate limiting) and entity and endpoint pages. Format and access: web APIs documented on the developer site; requests are authenticated, as the getting-started guide explains, so users must obtain credentials first. Licence and cost: use is free of charge and encouraged, provided services credit the source as incorporated from EuRIS. Caveats: coverage and data depth vary by national authority, and rate limits apply. The feeds can drive digital twins and network flow models of inland navigation with live lock and fairway status. It relates to the EURIS inland fairway network graphs and the EuRIS notices to skippers dataset in the catalogue.
